contract.intent: Write the FRESH requirements spec for Ann — clean-room, elicited rung-by-rung from the user (existing docs were reference only, not template). Supersedes ann-spec.md per the complete-artifact rule.

Primary flow = configurable step chain (default template: idea → validate → envision → detailed specs → continue); steps are separately-managed gated nodes; flow config is data, not code

KPIs K1-K4 per accepted numbers (derived-state accuracy 100%, locate <=2 interactions, advance <=1, next-action correctness >=95%); failure signal = advance friction / wrong next-action across fixtures
Multi-user = design constraint (not v1 feature); no node-count limit in the format; big-data query performance N/A for v1
Spec locked (type=spec, upstream design v3); ann-spec gets a superseded event
requiredInputs: Elicited answers (this session): rungs 1-11 + contract — recorded in the spec itself
